subject: Ledger slicing & collections — multi-entity invoice routing
messages:
From: Elena Moreno <elena@novocare.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: NovoCare Finance <finance@novocare.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice split request for Q4 commitment

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for a great onboarding session last week. We received the consolidated invoice (attached) but NovoCare is two legal entities for billing — NovoCare US (PO: NC-US-1121) and NovoCare Labs EU (PO: NC-EU-332). We need the single PDF split into two payable invoices, with the cost split per the cost center matrix (attached). Also need VAT treatment clarified for the EU entity (reverse charge vs. Redwood remit).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood produce two invoice documents with the same invoice number suffixing with -US and -EU and with line-level allocations?
- Can you provide the ledger mapping (GL codes) and payment instructions for each entity so our AP team can route payments?

We aim to pay by 11/30 — happy to sign any amended invoice/ack if needed.

Elena
Elena Moreno
Head of Finance Operations | NovoCare Health
Attachment: NovoCare_Invoice_11092026.pdf; allocation_matrix_novocare.xlsx
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@novocare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 15:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice split request for Q4 commitment

Elena —

Thanks for the clear note and the matrix. We can do a line-level split and issue two sibling invoices (same root number + entity suffix). Quick plan:

1) Redwood will generate two PDFs and two AP records: Invoice# RF-20261109-001-US and RF-20261109-001-EU. The invoice numeration will preserve the original root for audit.
2) Marcus will prepare a ledger-slicing spec showing GL mapping and per-line cost center codes.
3) For the EU entity: we need the NovoCare EU VAT number and confirmation if reverse charge applies; if not, we'll include VAT on the EU invoice.
4) We'll include bank wiring instructions per-entity and a note about partial remittance mapping if they pay a consolidated sum.

If that sounds right I'll kick off the accounting task and ask Marcus for the spec and Rishi to confirm VAT handling and whether we should issue a credit note prior to the split (depending on our internal invoice id rules).

Also copying Marcus/Rishi to set expectations on timing — Elena suggested payment by 11/30. We can have drafts out by 11/12.

Cheers,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice split request for Q4 commitment

Tessa / Lauren —

Attached is a first-pass ledger-slicing spec (redwood-ledger-slice-spec.md). Key points:

- Approach: keep the original invoice metadata (date, purchase description) and create two child invoices with suffixes -US / -EU. Each child invoice will have a per-line allocation field (allocation_percent) which feeds into our billing database.
- GL mapping: we will map product revenue to GL codes per cost center column in the spreadsheet. Example:
   • Core API consumption -> GL 4001 (NC-US) / 4001-EU
   • Dedicated capacity surcharge -> GL 4208 (NC-US) / 4208-EU
- VAT: For EU entity, mark VAT_exempt = true if we receive a valid EU VAT ID + reverse charge flag. If not supplied, system will compute VAT at 20% for the EU invoice.
- Payment routing: each child invoice will include explicit remittance instructions and a short routing token in the payment reference (e.g., RF20261109-US:NC-US-1121). This token allows collections to auto-apply payments to both the invoice and the cost center allocations.

I'll also attach an exportable allocation matrix (allocation_matrix_novocare.xlsx) with per-line percentages — that will be used to generate line items programmatically.

ETA: I can produce draft PDFs and the ledger spec in the next 48 hours once Elena confirms the VAT ID.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-ledger-slice-spec.md
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@novocare.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice split request for Q4 commitment

Hi Elena —

Quick follow-up on VAT: please confirm NovoCare Labs EU VAT ID and whether the EU entity will self-account under reverse charge. If you can paste the VAT ID here I'll validate format and run it through our compliance checks.

Notes for AP teams: when NovoCare pays a single consolidated amount to Redwood, include the payment reference token (RF20261109-ALL) and provide an allocation instruction (we can accept a single payment and auto-apply across two invoices only if the remittance file includes a per-split breakdown). Absent that, the payment will be applied to the Primary child invoice by default.

Also: if NovoCare prefers, we can sign an amended invoice packet (DocuSign) that lists both child invoices and the allocation matrix to keep your internal auditors happy. Tessa — do you want me to generate the DocuSign packet or leave it until invoices are finalized?

-Rishi
Head of Financial Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Moreno <elena@novocare.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, NovoCare Finance <finance@novocare.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice split request for Q4 commitment

Thanks all — confirmed VAT ID: EU-GB-8892731. NovoCare confirms reverse charge applies. We'll arrange a single wire but will include the per-entity allocation in the remittance advice (we'll send the bank confirmation to your AP inbox). Please proceed with sibling invoices and the DocuSign packet so our auditors have a signed breakdown.

Two quick clarifications:
- Please ensure invoice line descriptions carry the internal cost center code (e.g., CC-ENG-01) so our ERP mapping can ingest automatically.
- Can you include a short paragraph on the PDF stating: "If payment is made as a consolidated remittance, Redwood will allocate funds according to the attached allocation matrix and post receipts to the child invoices listed."

If you can get drafts to us by EOD 11/18 we'll review and confirm payment schedule.

Best,
Elena
